description: This public GitHub repository lists operating data for the pit thermal energy store at Høje Taastrup, Denmark, connected to the Copenhagen district-heating system. The article documents 2024 monitoring of water temperature and charging and discharging in a large store used on one- to two-week cycles. The current repository Data folder lists separate CSV files labelled 2023, 2024 and 2025, plus a treatment notebook. GitHub contains a BSD 3-Clause licence; an earlier Zenodo archive of the same project describes its version 0.1 under CC BY 4.0, so the two distribution rights are recorded separately. Coverage is one thermal store, not the full Copenhagen network or a validated multi-site storage sample. Sensor placement, stratification and uneven monitoring periods are limitations when transferring operating parameters. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating storage losses or dispatch in heat-network simulations. case_study-hoje-taastrup-pit-thermal-energy-storage describes this installation without publishing these CSVs, while model-tespy is a related heat-system model. No data or notebook was downloaded.
